title: File handling
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: File handling
objectives: know how to open a text file, read what is in it and close it again
understand what write mode does to a file, and how append mode differs from it
know how to split one line of a file into its separate fields and use them
starter: A program opens scores.txt in write mode, and the file already holds 40 lines. Write down what the file holds the moment that line has run, and which mode should have been used to add to it instead.
